row.name: Thalassery Mess
row.reviews_list:
[('Rated 3.5', 'RATED
  Visited them on Sunday. The approach road is through Bommanahalli. Would recommend to go on two wheeler . Car parking is a challenge. Now coming to the food it was yum. The Beef Biryani was really good and is a must try. Chilli chicken was also good and Kerela Parota was also nice and piping hot. The puttu was also soft and nice. Apart from the kids liked the chicken curry as it was not that spicy and kids enjoyed it . Also tried the Fish curry which was fine. Sorry no pics this time as we were too hungry and just dived into our food.

Would recommend to try them if looking to try out mess food nearby HSR. As very few Kerela mess are there . Also avoid taking a car as parking is a challenge . You need to park on main road and walk.'), ('Rated 3.5', 'RATED
